# HumanifyLab

> HumanifyLab is a professional AI humanizer. It rewrites AI-generated text from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other models into natural, human-like writing that passes AI detection tools such as Turnitin, GPTZero, Originality.ai, ZeroGPT and Copyleaks — while preserving the original meaning. A free plan with monthly word credits is available; no sign-up is required to try it.

Key facts:
- Product: web-based AI text humanizer at https://www.humanifylab.com
- Input: paste text or upload .txt, .docx and .pdf files
- Output: rewritten text that scores as human-written on major AI detectors
- Speed: results in under 10 seconds for typical documents
- Pricing: free plan with monthly word credits; paid plans with higher limits, faster processing and API access
- Privacy: content is encrypted in transit and at rest; user text is never used for model training
- Teams: collaborative workspaces with shared credits and centralized billing on premium plans
